checks.finding:
**1. The fallback branch that keeps first-line detection has no test, so deleting it turns `base`-detected binary into text and nothing goes red.**

`src/input.rs:284-288` replaces the snapshot with the first 1024 bytes of `first_line` when `read_until` had to read past the snapshot. That happens whenever the first `read()` returns a short chunk with no newline in it. A custom `BufRead` can do that, and so can an ordinary `StdinLock` on a pipe.

Concrete case: `(printf 'ab'; sleep 1; printf 'c\0d\n') | bat`. The snapshot is `ab`, `first_line` is `abc\0d\n`. `base` inspects the whole first line and says BINARY. With this PR it says BINARY only because of lines 284-288; remove them and it says UTF-8, which is the bug this PR fixes coming back on a different path.

None of the new tests reach that branch:
- `binary_detection_scans_beyond_first_line_and_preserves_input` (`src/input.rs:435`) reads from a `&[u8]`, whose `fill_buf` exposes all 1025 bytes at once.
- `input_detection_does_not_read_twice` (`src/input.rs:457`) uses inputs that fit in one read.
- `header_binary_with_null_after_first_line` (`tests/integration_tests.rs:2269`) reads a 28-byte file through an 8 KiB `BufReader`.

One unit test covers it: `InputReader::new(BufReader::with_capacity(2, &b"abc\0d\n"[..]))` should give `Some(ContentType::BINARY)`. It passes with the branch and fails without it.
checks.evidence: Not run: the offline rules allow only read-only git/ls/wc, so no cargo test. Read the code path instead. src/input.rs:284-288 (added by this PR, per `git diff base...HEAD -- src/input.rs`) swaps the fill_buf snapshot for the first 1024 bytes of first_line only when `first_line.len().min(1024) > inspection_prefix.len()`, i.e. when the first fill_buf exposed fewer bytes than the first line and fewer than 1024. Stdin reaches try_new as a caller-supplied BufRead (src/input.rs:194, 212), so a pipe whose first read() returns `ab` gives snapshot `ab` and read_until keeps reading to `abc\0d\n`; without 284-288, inspect_content_type(b"ab") returns UTF_8, while base inspected the whole first_line and got BINARY. No test reaches the branch: every unit test feeds `&[u8]` or `Cursor` (src/input.rs:392, 421, 440, 452, 505, 536, 566, 596, 619), whose fill_buf returns all remaining bytes, so the snapshot always covers min(first_line, 1024); `input_detection_does_not_read_twice` (src/input.rs:457-479) wraps a single-read `OneRead` in an 8 KiB BufReader, whose one read holds the whole `text\n` line; the new CLI test `header_binary_with_null_after_first_line` (tests/integration_tests.rs:2267-2285) writes a 28-byte file that the 8 KiB BufReader reads in one call. grep finds no `BufReader::with_capacity` or chunking reader in src/ or tests/. The lines are new in this PR, so it's this PR's gap.
